Implementation: [libs/tts/providers/MsEdgeTTSProvider.ts](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/libs/tts/providers/MsEdgeTTSProvider.ts).
Package entry points: `retiam/tts`.

items: MsEdgeTTSProvider: High-performance, studio-quality Text-To-Speech provider utilizing Microsoft Edge's neural voice infrastructure (Azure Speech Read Aloud service). Features: - 320+ neural voices across 70+ languages and dialects with natural prosody. - Zero model weight download overhead (runs instantly without loading gigabyte neural weights). - Full support for word boundary metadata for precision closed-caption timing. - Direct in-process execution in Node.js (CLI video rendering, scripts, unit tests). - Seamless client proxying in browser development environments via Vite server middleware.
